The little details

Good to know

We’re getting the finishing touches ready. Here’s what this preview can tell you today.

Are these real products and prices?+

No. This storefront uses clearly marked sample listings to demonstrate the shopping experience. Final product names, brands, ingredient lists, prices and availability need to be entered and verified by the store owner.

Can I place an order here?+

This preview has a working sample bag, but checkout is not connected to an order system. No order, payment or reservation is created here.

Do you deliver across Sri Lanka?+

Islandwide delivery and cash on delivery are shown as planned store options. Delivery coverage, charges and service terms must be confirmed before launch.

How should I use a mask?+

Always follow the verified instructions and warnings supplied with the specific product. Patch test new products and stop using a product if irritation occurs.
